threads_evidence: job.sh validates 24 physical cores before running replay.cpp at 1, 8 and 24 threads on one booked quarter

estimate_basis.reason: 72 natural and 16 stress decisions over three thread widths, eight interleaved timing blocks per width, plus complete output hashing. Smoke measures one native model decision and four head replays.

model: Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 CPU, native V10 production CPU libraries at ffc1bac82 read-only, no server
decision_rule: Timing and correctness diagnostic. Question: does signed Q15 remove FP32-reference held-out greedy mismatches and improve replay throughput? Compare final-head logits for fixed activations, Q8 weight bytes, and greedy selection at t1/t8/t24. Higher full-head evaluations per second is better. Measure eight paired, interleaved rounds and same-count Q8 A/A floor, independently time packing. Checkpoints after real model capture, each thread width and report validation. Stop on answer once these units and the signed-word scalar oracle are valid. Stop on futility on missing input or library mismatch, failed oracle, or absent replay coverage. NO_KEEP on any new held-out mismatch or throughput no higher than native Q8 and matched Q8 plus floor. Diagnostic only.
notes: A controlled head-local diagnostic. One full physical quarter is necessary for the main 24-thread timing coverage; the smoke runs a single real model decision and one row through each arm.
